units.source_text: 到了十一月，宫中祭祀典礼甚多，内侍所事务繁忙。

en.t: When the eleventh month arrived, there were many ritual ceremonies at court, and the Naishidokoro was busy with its duties.

units.source_text: 典侍、掌侍等次级女官，频频到六条院来向尚侍请示，

en.t: Junior court ladies such as the Naishi no suke and Naishi no jo often came to Rokujo-in to consult the Naishi no kami,

units.source_text: 玉鬘的房中座上客满，十分热闹。

en.t: so Tamakazura's rooms were filled with callers and were very lively.

units.source_text: 但髭黑大将白昼也不回去，在这里东躲西闪，

en.t: But General Higekuro would not go home even in daylight, and kept hiding and slipping about there,

units.source_text: 玉鬘很讨厌他。

en.t: which Tamakazura found deeply unpleasant.

units.source_text: 许多失恋者之中，萤兵部卿亲王尤为伤心。

en.t: Among the many disappointed suitors, Prince Hotaru, the Minister of War, was especially heartbroken.

units.source_text: 式部卿亲王的儿子左兵卫督除了失恋之外，

en.t: The Captain of the Left Division of the Palace Guards, son of Prince Shikibukyo, had not only lost in love,

units.source_text: 又因其姐为了玉鬘而被髭黑大将遗弃，为世人所取笑，

en.t: but his elder sister had also been abandoned by General Higekuro because of Tamakazura and had become the laughingstock of society,

units.source_text: 所以加倍痛恨。

en.t: so his resentment was doubled.

units.source_text: 然而他又想回来：事已如此，痛恨无益，反见其愚。

en.t: Yet he thought better of it: since things had come to this, hatred would do no good and would only make him look foolish.

units.source_text: 髭黑大将原是个有名的忠厚长者，

en.t: General Higekuro had originally been known as a sincere and respectable gentleman,

units.source_text: 多年来从未有过轻薄好色的行为。

en.t: and for many years he had never behaved in a frivolous or lustful way.

units.source_text: 然而现在完全变了样，对玉鬘一往情深，

en.t: But now he had changed completely and was passionately devoted to Tamakazura,

units.source_text: 其贪色之状竟像另换了一个人。

en.t: and his amorous behavior made him seem as if he had become another person altogether.

units.source_text: 偷偷摸摸地宵来晓去，

en.t: He came secretly at night and left at dawn,

units.source_text: 打扮成一个艳丽的风流男子，众侍女看了都觉得好笑。

en.t: dressing himself up like a splendid man of fashion, which all the gentlewomen found amusing to watch.

units.source_text: 玉鬘本性愉快活泼，

en.t: Tamakazura was cheerful and lively by nature,

units.source_text: 但现在笑容尽敛，一味心思郁结。

en.t: but now her smiles had vanished, and she did nothing but brood in distress.

units.source_text: 此事本非出于她的心愿，乃众所周知。

en.t: Everyone knew that this affair had never arisen from her own wishes.

units.source_text: 然而她不知源氏太政大臣对此事作何感想。

en.t: Yet she did not know what Genji, the Grand Minister, thought of the matter.

units.source_text: 又回想萤兵部卿亲王的深情厚谊，以及风流儒雅之状，

en.t: When she recalled Prince Hotaru's deep affection and kindness, and his elegant, cultivated manner,

units.source_text: 便觉自己可耻可惜，因此对髭黑大将一直没有好感。

en.t: she felt ashamed and full of regret, and for that reason she never felt any liking for General Higekuro.
